### Bio:

I am an M.S. student in Biostatistics at UCLA with a background in Biological Sciences and a strong interest in integrating statistical methods with biological and biomedical applications. My research experience spans bioinformatics and Bayesian inference, including transcriptomic data analysis and developing probabilistic models for biological data. I have also gained industry experience in biotech and pharmaceutical settings, where I worked on data science and decision analytics projects to support research and development. More broadly, I am interested in applying data-driven approaches to improve health outcomes and inform scientific discovery. Outside of academics, I enjoy bouldering, hiking, and reading.
